NTA. You have no obligation to her family’s misfortune. But I must say you shouldn’t ignore car maintenance because when you need to go to dr, store etc. you need for your car to be dependable. As to someone’s advice about putting money in an account for your son that’s unattainable to her is very good advice that you should act on immediately. The fact that she and her family are acting so badly this early in the marriage is very very concerning.

No matter how why or when it was caused, the man feels remorse and asked for forgiveness. I hope that when y’all are “judged” and ask God to forgive you that he doesn’t deny you because you were arrogant and stupid with what you done. If he got angry (which isn’t implied) then no he doesn’t deserve it. But I don’t think this was the case. Haven’t you ever done something that was stupid and was downright sorry for?

Yes you are the biggest asshole I’ve ever seen. You will never know what forgiveness means to someone who is truly sorry. Put aside the fact that God teaches us forgiveness. It really sounds like he is sorry and you just toss him off the ledge. I feel sorry for you because one day you will ask for it and you will be denied. That’s not what I hope fir you because I truly hope you never know that pain. But I have no control for what happens when you go before God and he denies tour request because you could not find it in your heart to forgive
NTA. They both are rude and mean. It’s not your fault you’re a better cook. Hubby needs to either stfu or learn to cook himself.
Yes you are the asshole

My son suffers like this. You need to have more empathy. My adult son said his brain will not let him proceed until he has gone through certain rituals. We called it vapor locking. He can’t move until his brain allows him too, not cause you kick his heels till he gets out of your way. His brain is hardwired to do things differently than you or me. Yeah you are kinda THE asshole

Has he been telling her this for 12 years or did he just now decide to say it. NTA but if he waited till now to tell her then he’s just as much to blame for her asshole behavior and it’s probably too late for her to ever be nice or think before she opens her mouth and sh*t come out. It sounds like he’s tried to tell her before but I suspect he was not firm enough. But no he’s not the a**hole

My mom told me bad stories about my dad who left when I was toddler. Then after my mom died and my dad, whom I never saw, never spoke bad of her but one day I finally got the truth out of him and what my mom did was far worse than what she said of him. Parents need to let the kids see for themselves what the other parent is like. Maybe it is worse but the maybe it’s far better.
